admin_users_auth_method_chk.name: admin_users_auth_method_chk
admin_users_auth_method_chk.value: "admin_users"."auth_subject" is not null or "admin_users"."password_hash" is not null

audit_events_actor_consistency_chk.name: audit_events_actor_consistency_chk
audit_events_actor_consistency_chk.value: ("audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'admin' and "audit_events"."actor_admin_user_id" is not null) or ("audit_events"."actor_kind" <> 'admin' and "audit_events"."actor_admin_user_id" is null)

inventory_reservations_lifecycle_chk.name: inventory_reservations_lifecycle_chk
inventory_reservations_lifecycle_chk.value: ("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'active' and "inventory_reservations"."consumed_at" is null and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is null) or ("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'consumed' and "inventory_reservations"."consumed_at" is not null and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is null) or ("inventory_reservations"."status" in ('released', 'expired') and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is not null and "inventory_reservations"."consumed_at" is null)

order_addresses_review_consistency_chk.name: order_addresses_review_consistency_chk
order_addresses_review_consistency_chk.value: ("order_addresses"."review_status" = 'pending' and "order_addresses"."reviewed_at" is null and "order_addresses"."reviewed_by" is null) or ("order_addresses"."review_status" <> 'pending' and "order_addresses"."reviewed_at" is not null)

order_events_actor_consistency_chk.name: order_events_actor_consistency_chk
order_events_actor_consistency_chk.value: ("order_events"."actor_kind" = 'admin' and "order_events"."actor_admin_user_id" is not null) or ("order_events"."actor_kind" <> 'admin' and "order_events"."actor_admin_user_id" is null)

orders_timestamp_status_chk.name: orders_timestamp_status_chk
orders_timestamp_status_chk.value: ("orders"."status" not in ('paid', 'preparing', 'out_for_delivery', 'delivered') or "orders"."paid_at" is not null) and ("orders"."status" <> 'cancelled' or "orders"."cancelled_at" is not null) and ("orders"."status" <> 'delivered' or "orders"."delivered_at" is not null)

payment_attempts_link_sent_chk.name: payment_attempts_link_sent_chk
payment_attempts_link_sent_chk.value: "payment_attempts"."status" not in ('link_sent', 'authorized', 'declined', 'expired', 'refunded') or "payment_attempts"."link_sent_at" is not null

payment_attempts_expiration_chk.name: payment_attempts_expiration_chk
payment_attempts_expiration_chk.value: "payment_attempts"."expires_at" is null or ("payment_attempts"."link_sent_at" is not null and "payment_attempts"."expires_at" > "payment_attempts"."link_sent_at")

payment_attempts_authorized_chk.name: payment_attempts_authorized_chk
payment_attempts_authorized_chk.value: "payment_attempts"."status" not in ('authorized', 'refunded') or "payment_attempts"."authorized_at" is not null

payment_attempts_terminal_timestamp_chk.name: payment_attempts_terminal_timestamp_chk
payment_attempts_terminal_timestamp_chk.value: ("payment_attempts"."status" <> 'declined' or "payment_attempts"."declined_at" is not null) and ("payment_attempts"."status" <> 'expired' or "payment_attempts"."expired_at" is not null) and ("payment_attempts"."status" <> 'cancelled' or "payment_attempts"."cancelled_at" is not null) and ("payment_attempts"."status" <> 'refunded' or "payment_attempts"."refunded_at" is not null)

payment_reconciliations_authorized_refs_.name: payment_reconciliations_authorized_refs_chk
payment_reconciliations_authorized_refs_.value: "payment_reconciliations"."result" <> 'authorized' or ("payment_reconciliations"."authorization_code" is not null and ("payment_reconciliations"."provider_nsu" is not null or "payment_reconciliations"."acquirer_nsu" is not null))

program_catalogs_validity_chk.name: program_catalogs_validity_chk
program_catalogs_validity_chk.value: "program_catalogs"."valid_from" is null or "program_catalogs"."valid_until" is null or "program_catalogs"."valid_until" >= "program_catalogs"."valid_from"

program_catalogs_publication_chk.name: program_catalogs_publication_chk
program_catalogs_publication_chk.value: ("program_catalogs"."status" = 'published' and "program_catalogs"."published_at" is not null and "program_catalogs"."published_by" is not null) or ("program_catalogs"."status" <> 'published')

variant_program_items_approval_chk.name: variant_program_items_approval_chk
variant_program_items_approval_chk.value: ("variant_program_items"."is_approved" = true and "variant_program_items"."approved_at" is not null and "variant_program_items"."approved_by" is not null) or ("variant_program_items"."is_approved" = false and "variant_program_items"."approved_at" is null and "variant_program_items"."approved_by" is null)
